picker.title: Choose a server
picker.looking: Looking for servers on this network…
picker.noneAnswered: No server answered. Check that Pley is running on it, or enter its address.
picker.enterAddress: Enter an address such as nas, 192.168.1.20 or https://pley.example.com.
picker.notEncrypted: {{address}} isn't encrypted: your password and what you watch could be read on the way. Open it by its https address.
picker.notYours: Another device answers at {{address}} now, so Pley came back here.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.hint: They play in your video player, even when the server is away.

said.notPleyHttp: it answered HTTP {{status}}, so it isn't a Pley server
said.notYours: another device answers there (if your server was set up anew, forget it and connect again)
said.provesItselfAs: it proves itself as {{address}} here: the proxy in front of it must pass on the Host and X-Forwarded-Proto it was asked with
said.networkChanged: the network changed: open it again
said.notMedia: Pley keeps audio and video files only.
said.namedOtherwise: The server names itself otherwise here: check the proxy in front of it.
said.anotherDevice: Another device answers at this server's address.
said.notOnServer: This file is no longer on the server.
said.signedOut: Sign in to the server again, then download it again.
said.cantMake: The server can't make files for this computer's player: update it.
said.notMade: The server couldn't make it for this computer.
said.notMadeBecause: The server couldn't make it for this computer: {{detail}}
said.unreadable: The server's answer can't be read.
said.busy: The server can't make it right now.
said.dropped: The connection to the server dropped.
said.notSent: The server couldn't send the file.

notices.specialsReady: Specials of {{title}} are ready to watch.
